integrity: An analytical proof establishes the universal distributional law and moment divergence; exact-rational cases and numerical density integrations are independent supporting checks, not infinite proofs. Related prior methods and a scalar earlier mechanism are distinguished; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real SPD systems, nonbreakdown Lanczos, one exact k-step Galerkin inverse with iid Gaussian sketches; unconditional law. Does not analyze conditional embedding events, sketched harmonic or least-squares projection, structured sketches, restart, or floating-point arithmetic.
title: Exact Cauchy-tail law for Gaussian-sketched Lanczos Galerkin inverses
